--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+---
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'N5: the doctor subcommand for a foreign agent'
+---
+## What
+
+Milestone **N5** of this repository's `cli-plan.md` §10.
+
+Asked for by `FoundationModelsACPAgent`, card `^3jdqyn5`.
+
+`acp-client doctor -- <agent-command>` answers one question about a
+foreign agent: is it usable? One `Doctorable` conformance over an agent
+command:
+
+| Check | Catches |
+|---|---|
+| The command exists on `PATH`, or at the given path, and it is executable | A typing mistake, or a binary that was not built |
+| The process starts, and it does not exit at once | A missing runtime, or a crash on start |
+| It writes valid ndJSON, and nothing else, to stdout | An agent that prints a banner to stdout |
+| `initialize` answers inside the time limit | An agent that hangs |
+| The protocol version is one we support | A v1 agent, or a newer draft |
+| The advertised capabilities are readable | A malformed `initialize` result |
+| The process ends when its stdin closes, and it leaves no child | A leaked agent |
+
+The third row is worth the command on its own: "the agent MUST NOT write
+non-ACP content to stdout" is a protocol MUST, and an agent that breaks
+it fails in a way that looks like a parsing bug in the CLIENT.
+
+**Rendering.** The human table goes to stderr through this repository's
+`TerminalRenderer` when stderr is a terminal, and through the Extras
+plain-text renderer otherwise. `--json` writes the report to stdout.
+Exit 0, 1 or 5.
+
+Every check carries a timeout. Name it in seconds. `doctor` must never
+hang.
+
+**The Extras dependency is ready.** The `Doctorable` module is on
+`FoundationModelsExtras` `main` at `55d6b04`: `HealthStatus`,
+`HealthCheck` (`name`, `status`, `message`, `fix`, `category`),
+`Doctorable` (`doctorName`, `doctorCategory`, `isApplicable`,
+`runHealthChecks()`), `DoctorReport` (`checks`, `worstStatus`,
+`exitCode`) and `DoctorRunner`. A `main` branch dependency stays pinned
+by revision until `swift package update` runs, so run it first.
+
+**Two rules the module keeps, and this card must keep too.** A check
+NEVER throws: a component that cannot run reports its own failure as a
+`HealthCheck` with the `error` status, so one broken check cannot stop
+the others. Every `warning` and every `error` carries a `fix` string.
+
+- [ ] The `Doctorable` conformance, with the seven checks
+- [ ] The terminal and the plain rendering paths
+- [ ] `--json` to stdout, and the three exit codes
+- [ ] `swift package update` so the new Extras `Doctorable` surface
+      resolves
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A stub that writes a banner to stdout gives that row an `.error`.
+- [ ] A stub that never answers `initialize` gives a timeout `.warning`
+      inside the named limit, and the command does not hang.
+- [ ] A command that does not exist gives an `.error` naming it.
+- [ ] Exit 0 for all `.ok`, 1 for any `.error`, 5 for warnings only.
+- [ ] `--json` decodes to the same checks the table shows.
+- [ ] Every `.warning` and `.error` carries a non-nil `fix`.
+
+## Tests
+
+Two new stub agents are necessary, and both are a few lines: one that
+writes a banner to stdout, and one that never answers.
+
+- [ ] The banner stub gives an `.error` on the ndJSON row.
+- [ ] The silent stub gives a timeout `.warning`, and the test asserts
+      the elapsed time is under the limit.
+- [ ] A nonexistent command gives an `.error`.
+- [ ] The three exit codes, one test each.
+- [ ] `--json` decodes and matches.
+- [ ] With a non-terminal destination the output holds no ANSI escape.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+**A caution measured in the agent repository.** Do NOT model "never
+answers" with a never-resumed `withCheckedContinuation`. That prints
+`SWIFT TASK CONTINUATION MISUSE` and leaves a suspended task. Make the
+stub wait and answer late instead, which is cancellable.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m231bzp1xsgthg5v84b49jte
+  text: |-
+    Picked up. Research done.
+
+    **`swift package update` ran first.** FoundationModelsExtras resolved at `main (55d6b04)`, the revision the card names. `Package.resolved` is in `.gitignore`, so no diff shows the pin.
+
+    **What the code already gives, row by row.** Earlier cards built the whole doctor: `Doctor checks 1 and 2` (^btzvb81), `Doctor checks 3 to 5` (^af0jrf7), `Doctor checks 6 and 7` (^3y93w4), `Implement the doctor subcommand: render the report, --json, and exit 0, 1 or 5` (^39xrxnp), and `Wire --frames into doctor` (^3et20e2). `cli-plan.md` section 15 marks N5 as Done.
+
+    - `Sources/AcpClientCore/AgentCommandDoctor.swift` is the one `Doctorable`. It reports the seven rows of section 10 in a fixed order, `runHealthChecks()` does not throw, and every warning and error carries a fix. Proven by `AgentCommandDoctorTests.everyFindingObeysTheFixRule` (integration) and the unit `AgentCommandDoctorTests` for the four resolution failures.
+    - Every check that waits has a named limit in seconds: `defaultTimeLimit` (10 s), `settleInterval` (500 ms), `teardownInterval` (2 s). Rows 1 and 6 do not wait: one reads the file system, one decodes bytes.
+    - `Sources/AcpClientCore/DoctorCommand.swift` writes the plain report through `PlainTextDoctorRenderer`, writes `--json` as one ndJSON record, and exits through `AcpClientExitCode.forDoctorStatus(_:)`: 0, 1 or 5.
+    - The two stubs the card asks for exist in `IntegrationTests/.../Support/StubAgents.swift`: `makeBannerOnStdoutAgent` and `makeSilentAgent`. The silent stub is a shell script that blocks on `cat`, so it holds no continuation at all.
+    - Tests that exist: banner gives `.error` on the ndJSON row and exit 1; a nonexistent command gives `.error` naming it and exit 1; exit 0, 1 and 5 each have a test; `--json` names match `AgentCommandDoctor.checkNamesInOrder`; a silent agent returns inside a named bound (20 s in the row test, 60 s in the binary test).
+
+    **What the card asks for that no test proves yet.**
+
+    1. "With a non-terminal destination the output holds no ANSI escape." No test reads the bytes for the escape byte.
+    2. "`--json` decodes to the same checks the table shows." The existing test compares names only. No test decodes the JSON into `DoctorReport` and compares it with the plain form, which is what the N3+N4 card did for `probe`.
+
+    **One stale comment.** The doc comment on `DoctorCommand.write(_:asJSON:)` says the renderer "reads the destination itself and writes color only into a terminal". The Extras source at 55d6b04 says the opposite: "A terminal, a pipe and a file each receive the same rendering, so this renderer reads nothing about the handle", and no `isatty` or `useColor` was ever in that file. The comment is corrected as part of the rendering path work.
+
+    **Two card items conflict with the documented contract of this repository.** Both are recorded as blockers below, and neither is resolved here.
+
+    - The card says the human table goes to stderr through a `TerminalRenderer` when stderr is a terminal. `cli-plan.md` section 8 says `doctor` is the exception to the stdout rule: "Their report is their output, so it goes to stdout." Section 5 says "A table has no caller, because section 8 sends the probe report and the doctor report to stdout, and this layer writes to stderr only." No `TerminalRenderer` exists in this repository; section 5 records that name as the agent package's file. `DoctorCommandTests` pins stdout and an empty stderr.
+    - The card says a silent stub gives a timeout `.warning`. The done cards ^af0jrf7 and ^39xrxnp decided `.error` and exit 1, and both suites pin it. Section 10 gives row 7 a warning because "such an agent answered every request, so it is usable"; an agent that never answers is not usable.
+
+    Plan: add the two missing tests under `/tdd`, correct the stale comment, run both suites, and report `stuck` with the two conflicts named.

 position_column: doing
